_readme: S359 SkyMoss, 2026-10-10. The seven RCCD Liberal Arts emphasis degrees (Administration & Information Systems; Communication, Media & Languages; Fine & Applied Arts; Humanities, Philosophy & Arts; Kinesiology, Health and Wellness; Math & Sciences; Social and Behavioral Studies) found no page at any of the district's three colleges in S358's reads (21 programs; memory row roep-district-liberal-arts-emphases-miss-2026-10-10). The college read walks only the top sections whose title names a degree, certificate, program, major or award (CQ_SECTION) and keeps an entry only when its title names an award after a dash (cq_is_program). This read asks Riverside City's catalog (124) where the emphases sit: its top navigation, and the Degrees and Certificates Index list (6323) the walk already reads. Two JSON loads, no model call.

questions.where_listed: Which section and list name the Liberal Arts degree or its emphases, and how each entry's title is written.
questions.entry_ids: The outline id of each Liberal Arts entry, for a second read of its page.
